reply_text:
I answered Marcus in a reply to his #north-team message: use **10 June** for the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date.

On 14 Oct Ilse first posted 25 November in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is a member of #north-random, so he could already see that correction. I didn't check the date against the contract.
